journal.title: Custody journal
journal.subtitle: Write down the facts as they happen: handovers, delays, changes, health, school. Visible only to you, exportable as a PDF.
journal.private: Private: the other parent never sees your journal.
journal.bodyPlaceholder: E.g.: handover planned at 6 pm, kids picked up at 6:40 pm, no message beforehand.
journal.tip: Tip: stick to the facts (who, what, when). A neutral journal is more useful and more credible than an emotional account.
journal.deleteConfirmBody: It will disappear from your journal and from future exports.
journal.emptyBody: Add a first note: a handover, a delay, a doctor's appointment… Each note is dated and time-stamped when you write it.
journal.exportHint: Leave empty to export everything. The export page opens; use “Print” then “Save as PDF”.
journal.docDisclaimer: This document contains personal notes written by their author in the Alternly app. Each note shows the date and time it was recorded, saved automatically, and where applicable when it was last edited. It is not a certified record.
